title: [@@@ocaml.flambda_oclassic] stays in force for the next units of the same command
summary: `[@@@ocaml.flambda_oclassic]` in one unit stays in force for the units compiled after it by the same command. `ocamlopt -c classic.ml test.ml` compiles `test.ml` without Simplify and its `[@zero_alloc]` check fails; `ocamlopt -c test.ml` succeeds.

actual.text: `Error: Annotation check for zero_alloc failed on function Test.add3`; exit status 2.

cause: `parsing/builtin_attributes.ml` sets `opt_level` (`driver/oxcaml_flags.ml`), one reference for the process, which is not restored between files.
